newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Jabil Circuit raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Jabil Circuit raised.

text.p: Robertson, Stephens & Co analyst Keith Dunne raised his rating and estimates for Jabil Circuit Inc, a maker of electronic manufacturing products.
-- raised rating to a buy from market performer. raised fiscal 1997, ending Aug. 1997, earnings estimate to $2.70/shr from $2.30, and raised fiscal 1998 to $4.20/shr from $2.80.
-- based higher expectations on the company's Q3, ended May 31, earnings of $0.76/shr on sales of $248 million. One year ago, company earned $0.33/shr on sales of $220 million.
-- said Jabil is a "best of breed" company in its market.
-- Jabil shrs were up 8 at 76-7/8 by mid-morning.
